entries.claim: The Latin text in this revision of Divinum Officium is used for comparison with the printed Missal.

locator.section: In vigilia Ascensionis; Oratio; Deus, a quo bona cuncta procedunt

entries.claim: In the Ascension Vigil, the page prints Deus, a quo bona cuncta procedunt through eadem faciamus (w001–w021), followed by the abbreviated Per Dominum cue. The full common conclusion (w022–w042) and separate Amen (w043) retain their distinct wording and ritual-boundary sources.

locator.section: Rubricae generales Missalis romani, nn. 511 d, 513 a, 514.

entries.claim: The celebrant says or sings the collect and its conclusion.

locator.section: Rubricae generales 115 a: Father-directed common conclusion

entries.claim: Rubricae generales 115 a prints the full twenty-one-word Per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum conclusion through per omnia saecula saeculorum and following Amen. It supports the supplied wording at w022–w042 and the separate w043 Amen after the proper page’s Per Dominum cue. Reader accents, ligatures, colon after tuum and uppercase Qui are declared editorial accidentals, not exact typography from this rubric. This use does not assign the response performer or prayer voice.

The cited page prints this prayer’s proper body and the abbreviated conclusion “Per Dóminum”. The full common conclusion and Amen are supplied separately in the reader, with its own accentuation, capitalization and punctuation.
